method: Use the current Washington State Parks address and published locate point. For Riverside, use the named Bowl and Pitcher campground point because the statewide park office point is several miles from the main campground. Seattle estimates use the fastest ordinary Google Maps route observed at review time and round up for towing, traffic, and pass conditions.

reviews.coordinate_source: Washington State Parks published locate point matched to the official campground address and map
reviews.route_note: Fastest normal I-90 and US-97 route at review time; public estimate adds towing and traffic margin. SR-20 is a slower seasonal alternative.
